title: Internal linking suggestions
subtitle: Review source-to-target opportunities derived from your latest content inventory and stored Search Console evidence. Nothing is applied to your site.

newRun.title: Prepare a suggestion run
newRun.description: Preview the exact inventory snapshot and allowance before you spend one run.
newRun.guidanceOnly: Suggestions are guidance only. RankMeFast does not edit your CMS or page HTML.

emptyRuns.title: No saved runs yet
emptyRuns.body: Preview a new run to see which stored inventory snapshot it will use.

emptySuggestions.title: No suggestions match
emptySuggestions.body: This run found no eligible pairs, or the current URL-backed filters hide them.

missing.title: Content inventory required
missing.body: Complete a content inventory before requesting suggestions. No run was spent.

stale.title: Content inventory is out of date
stale.body: Re-run your content inventory so suggestions use a recent stored snapshot. No run was spent.

cap.title: Monthly run allowance reached
cap.body: This request was not started. Wait for the next allowance period or review available plans.

disabled.title: Suggestion runs are unavailable
disabled.body: New internal-link runs are temporarily disabled. Saved runs remain available.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.body: Wait a moment before trying this action again.

notFound.title: Run not found
notFound.body: This saved run is unavailable for the current account.

failed.title: The run could not be completed
failed.body: No automatic changes were made. Try again later or open another saved run.

running.title: Building suggestions
running.body: The worker is ranking stored candidates and drafting anchors. This view updates automatically.

suggestions.title: Suggested links
suggestions.codeFixProblem: A relevant internal link is missing.
suggestions.codeFixWhy: The target has few inbound internal links and shares relevant search or heading context with the source.
suggestions.codeFixRecommendation: Add the link in the most relevant section of the source page, using the suggested anchor text when it reads naturally.
suggestions.fallback: AI ranking was unavailable or rejected. Deterministic, evidence-backed candidates are shown instead.
